prompt: A realistic still blended as a double exposure, like a 1960s spy-film title sequence: inside the silhouette of the main figure there is a second image of the rooftops of a 1920s city at night under a small red moon in burning amber and red. He stands right of centre, his face large in frame. 1920s: bare brick, a fire bucket, a crate of empty milk bottles, a wet stone floor. Outside the silhouette, deep black shadow broken by hard gold light. The face nearest the camera stays realistic and readable. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
